description: Asks to take the person's own domain off a project's previews: every address under it stops answering, and the previews keep their CodeGene addresses. Owners and admins of the project only. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. It does not change the domain's DNS records.

domain.description: The preview domain to remove, such as preview.acme.com.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: remove_preview_domain
title: Stop using a domain for previews
